opinions.text:
On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit.

Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted and the judgment is affirmed. Indian Towing Co. v. United States, 350 U. S. 61.
